summary: Practise AI impact assessment, risk controls and lifecycle monitoring using recognized frameworks. Review the five-day course outline.
lede: Responsible AI governance combines impact assessment, risk management and accountable data practices. For AI governance, risk and data specialists reviewing or overseeing AI systems, this course develops skills in mapping intended use and data flows, documenting dataset quality, and preparing impact assessments, risk registers and mitigation plans, with monitoring evidence linked to approval decisions.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who review, operate or oversee AI systems and need usable evidence on data, impacts, controls and accountability.
prerequisites: Working familiarity with AI or data-driven systems in a design, procurement, deployment, review or oversight role is expected. No programming is required; exercises use system documentation, spreadsheets and shared-document workflows.
